summary: Full-power adversarial audit of the spec-loop methodology: find weak points, gaming vectors, metric-validity holes, then synthesize focus-stabilizing fixes
logs: Auditing the real kit: qa_ledger.py (2153 lines), 6 skills, templates, 2 docs. 7 adversarial lenses.

synthesis.one_line_purpose: spec-loop is a single-operator harness for driving Claude Code through a non-trivial or risk-bearing change, using a deterministic ledger to keep an LLM from declaring itself done — it turns "the agent says it's fine" into a small set of measured facts (coverage, test counts, lint severities, diff size) plus an advisory convergence signal, and stops at a human merge gate.
synthesis.verdict: Useful method with a diamond bolted on. The core is genuinely good and rare: the two-category ledger (measured static-gate vs self-reported agent), the advisory-vs-fact split, the "converge don't chase zero" discipline, and the golden/PreToolUse invariant are real engineering that most "AI coding process" docs never attempt. But the kit does not hold itself to its own headline principle. Its stated law is "facts may block; guesses may only advise" and "maker != checker" — yet the four FACT gates (gate-check, golden-diff, pit-check, spec-check, ~550 lines) write nothing to the ledger and are wired into neither convergence nor readiness (grep of dev-loop/SKILL.md = 0 hits), while the SELF-REPORTED agent numbers (log-step) are exactly what drive the convergence signal. So in the runnable loop, guesses inform the KPI and facts only advise if a human remembers to run them by hand — the principle is inverted in code. Layered on top are prose guarantees the engine can't keep ("CONSTITUTION breach caps readiness ≤65 by construction" — the word never appears in 2153 lines) and a 30-point KPI dimension that silently zeroes on a doc/CLI heading mismatch the kit ships with. It is ~80% a real method and ~20% aspirational narrative plus one over-built facet. Fix the wiring and the honesty gap and it is a strong, shippable method; leave them and it is a polished thing whose most impressive gates nobody's workflow touches.

top_weaknesses.title: The four FACT gates are unwired: they write nothing to the ledger and neither converged nor readiness reads them, so 'facts block' is agent-goodwill only — while the self-reported agent numbers ARE what drive convergence (the method's central principle inverted)
top_weaknesses.fix: Persist gate verdicts via a new `log-gate` step (mirroring the existing static-gate step shape), and make _converged refuse and readiness hard-cap when the latest golden-diff=DIVERGE / gate-check=BLOCKER / pit-check=BELOW-GATE, reusing the cap plumbing at :859-866/:967-977. Wire gate-check --from-git into every code-changing pass (Phase 3) and golden-diff before judgment-day in the dev-loop SKILL. Leave pit-check tiered (scheduled, per CONSTITUTION:94) and spec-check advisory. Log golden-diff's 'no .received' path (:1940-1942) as NOT-RUN, never as pass. This dedupes the diamond, goals, and coherence lenses which all report the same defect.

top_weaknesses.title: The headline KPI scores SILENCE as success: static_gate (20) and convergence (15) default to a perfect 1.0 when the linters/tools never ran, and coverage gives full credit at threshold regardless of test effectiveness — so absence of measurement reads as absence of defects
top_weaknesses.fix: Distinguish 'never measured' from 'clean', reusing the pattern already at :954-955 (integ_dim=0.0 when required-but-never-run): for a lint-capable repo with empty _latest_static_by_tool, set static_dim to UNMEASURED/capped rather than 1.0; same for convergence. Separately, add a conditional readiness cap in _apply_caps that fires ONLY when a PIT report EXISTS and mutation_score < min-score (a present-and-failing fact blocks; absence advises) — do NOT force PIT into every readiness call. This dedupes the two metric-lens coverage/static findings.

top_weaknesses.title: CONSTITUTION enforcement is prose, not code: SKILL.md:238 and CONSTITUTION.md:11/88 claim a breach 'caps readiness ≤65 and blocks convergence by construction', but the word CONSTITUTION appears nowhere in the 2153-line engine (grep = 1 code comment); escalate only caps ≤75 and only when not converged
top_weaknesses.fix: Two parts. (a) Now: soften the docs from 'by construction' to 'the agent must escalate' — the honest minimal correction. (b) Add a `flag-blocker --repo X --kind constitution --note ...` subcommand that writes a static-gate-shaped record carrying BOTH severity_counts={BLOCKER:1} AND a nonzero gated_reported, so _gate_open_and_sev/_apply_caps trip ≤65 AND _converged sees a non-clean gate. Keep --kind a free-text note; do not grow a severity taxonomy.

top_weaknesses.title: The heaviest KPI dimension (ADR=30) silently zeroes on a heading mismatch the kit ships with: adr-refine writes '## Definición de hecho' but SKILL.md:244 tells the operator to pass --section "Acceptance", so _parse_acceptance skips every checkbox and reports a fully-planned feature 30 points low with no error
top_weaknesses.fix: Pick ONE canonical heading and make template + SKILL + usage string agree. Simplest: drop --section from the documented readiness call (SKILL.md:243 and the usage string at :31) so it counts the whole ACCEPTANCE.md — this equals the already-correct CLI default. No code change to the parser needed.

top_weaknesses.title: gate-check's WEAKEN-the-measurer detection is defeatable by trivial reformatting: threshold-lowering requires adjacent -/+ lines with matching keywords, and test-deletion is skipped entirely when +++ is /dev/null (path→None → whole-file removals ignored) — so deleting a test file wholesale or splitting a config edit reads CLEAN
top_weaknesses.fix: Minimal, in-contract: (a) when +++ is /dev/null, recover file identity from the '--- a/...' line and still evaluate removed @Test/assert lines against it (:1669-1671); (b) track any removed _GC_THRESH key+number and match it against any added one for the SAME file across ALL hunks, not just the adjacent '-', plus flag deletion of a threshold key with no re-add; (c) wire in the executed-test-COUNT-vs-baseline check that the kit already computes (maven_test_count :170; rebuild compare :1207-1211) — a drop in test count is a heuristic-independent fact. Skip full structural config parsing and open-ended path broadening (over-correction, false-block risk).

top_weaknesses.title: The maker==checker leak in convergence: _converged and _tests_red trust the agent's self-reported --gated-reported / --tests-passed / --files-changed rather than measured output, so a lazy or gaming agent that logs only green converges over a red suite or unfixed HIGH findings
top_weaknesses.fix: Minimal, reusing existing parsers: make _converged's tests_ok (:642) PREFER the parsed snapshot failures/errors when a snapshot exists (mirroring the precedence _tests_red already uses at :848-851), falling back to the agent boolean only when no report is available. Do NOT rewire log-step to re-parse per pass (couples churn tracking to reports, adds ceremony). Note this is advisory-signal hardening — the engine-observed coverage floor and Phase-5 post-snapshot already prevent a forced-green PR factually.

top_weaknesses.title: The simplicity gate averages a gross size overrun away: seven linear-decay dims mean a diff ~1.9x over the added-lines budget still lands ACCEPTABLE because the cheap structural dims (nesting/files/hunks) are trivially green, and the only hard cap fires at 2x
top_weaknesses.fix: Apply the min()-floor discipline the kit already uses for the abstraction dimension (:1416-1419): the verdict must not reach SIMPLE/ACCEPTABLE while a heavy dim (diff_size or net_growth) is below a floor, instead of letting the weighted sum mask it. Prefer this over an arbitrary 'decay to 0 at 1.5x' constant (which would over-penalize legitimate 1.2-1.4x diffs). Keep the flag output as-is.

top_weaknesses.title: converged inspects the trailing k agent steps by count without checking tool identity, so padding the cycle with k clean throwaway log-step calls pushes real dirty findings out of the window and forces a converged reading
top_weaknesses.fix: Make the agent half of _converged iterate the LATEST agent step PER TOOL in qa_tools_order and require all listed tools present — symmetric with _latest_static_by_tool (:649-650, 'every tool's latest run is clean'). No new superseded-tracking bookkeeping needed. Note: this only hardens the advisory signal — the BLOCKER/CRITICAL and tests caps already run latest-per-tool, so the KPI itself isn't forced green by this.

top_weaknesses.title: Oscillation detection is off-by-default (needs a hand-supplied --fingerprint) and is exact period-2 hash equality, so a one-line churn that shifts a single finding-ID or any period-3+ loop is invisible — the SKILL's 'oscillation detected' escalation trigger effectively never fires
top_weaknesses.fix: Auto-derive fingerprints from finding-IDs the way ingest-gate already does (:597) so it's on by default, and detect recurrence by set-overlap/Jaccard over a window instead of fps[-1]==fps[-3]. Do NOT make 'no fingerprints' a blocking condition — oscillation is explicitly advisory (docstring :677), and blocking on a missing guess contradicts 'guesses may only advise'.

top_weaknesses.title: The golden-invariant hook is bypassable via Bash indirection: it blocks .approved writes only when a redirect/mv/cp keyword co-occurs, so `python -c open(p,'w')`, a var-indirected path, or writing the unprotected .received to equal the approved content all evade it
top_weaknesses.fix: One line: drop the second regex and block ANY Bash command whose string references a .approved path (hooks/block-approved-writes.ps1:29-30 → `if ($cmd -match '\.approved') { $block = $true }`). Golden files are binary and the agent has no legitimate Bash reason to touch an .approved path (it can still Read via the Read tool). Discard the ACL/checksum/harness-relocation additions (heavy infra for a solo kit, and variable resolution in a PreToolUse regex is infeasible).

top_weaknesses.title: check-coverage and rebuild trust a present-but-shrunken measurement surface: any jacoco.xml flips the gate to OK (covered=1/missed=0 → 100%), and rebuild's tests dimension (60% weight) rewards a test-COUNT ratio while preserved-but-gutted (assertion-stripped) tests still 'pass'
top_weaknesses.fix: For rebuild: store a per-test-file assertion COUNT alongside the already-collected test_file_set in _repo_signature (reuse the _GC_ASSERT regex at :1633) and dock tests_dim when density drops — prefer assertion-count over raw content-hash (hash false-positives on legitimate reformatting, e.g. javax→jakarta churn). For coverage: add an mtime/freshness check and a SOFT WARN when covered+missed collapses vs the prior snapshot's already-recorded prod_loc (:442-453); do NOT hard-reject on a small denominator (JaCoCo bytecode lines vs count_loc source lines are different units).

top_weaknesses.title: sys-doc's two-track CEO/technical HTML deck is hard-wired into mandatory dev-loop Phase 8 — a stakeholder-presentation deliverable orthogonal to 'idea → verified build', the clearest single instance of scope creep
top_weaknesses.fix: Move sys-doc out of the mandatory path into an explicitly optional 'reporting' add-on invoked only on request (a ~one-line edit at SKILL.md:248, reusing the '(optional; ...)' marker already used for Phase 5b at :190). Keep the ledger-driven retrospective in the core loop. This is pure ceremony removal, no new machinery.

top_weaknesses.title: Ship-config drift and mislabeled citations: qa_tools_order lists a non-existent skill 'improve-deep' (real skill is 'improve'), config self-reports version 1.2.0 while shipping CHANGELOGs to 1.2.9, and two CWE tags are wrong (CWE-1074 'deep inheritance' on a YAGNI rule; CWE-1121 'cyclomatic complexity' where nesting wants CWE-1124)
top_weaknesses.fix: Rename improve-deep→improve across config:15, SKILL.md:122/126/130 and workbench-doctor.sh:32 (pure doc consistency — the ledger/convergence math is name-agnostic, so no defect is being repaired, only operator confusion). Sync config version to real release (no code reads the field). Drop the CWE-1074 tag (CONSTITUTION:42); change CWE-1121→CWE-1124 in BOTH CONSTITUTION:43 and qa_ledger.py:1443 (the citation an operator actually sees in a finding).

commit_to: COMMIT: 'A single operator driving Claude Code through one non-trivial or risk-bearing change, kept honest by a deterministic ledger and a human merge gate.' Put this audience line at the top of dev-loop/SKILL.md and templates/CLAUDE.md — right now no artifact states who it's for, so it reads as universal (solo + team + greenfield + migration at once).

COMMIT: 'Facts block, guesses advise' as an ENFORCED property, not a slogan. That means the fact gates that CAN be measured cheaply and are already wired conceptually — gate-check on code-changing passes, golden-diff before judgment-day, the never-ran/absent distinction, and the CONSTITUTION flag-blocker — must actually feed converged/readiness. This is the one commitment that makes the whole method true instead of aspirational.

COMMIT: The deterministic ledger as the single source of truth for state, with a clear two-tier contract (measured static-gate/coverage/test-count = can block; self-reported agent counts = advisory, capped by measured facts). This design is the kit's genuine differentiator — sharpen and defend it rather than adding gates around it.
disclaim: DISCLAIM prominently: 'NOT for trivial or throwaway changes.' State that Profile-A work (one-file fix, config tweak) SKIPS discovery/ADR/sys-doc and runs build+test only — otherwise the 9-rule CLAUDE.md and 8-phase pipeline drag the whole machine behind a one-liner or get abandoned. Link the existing playbook Play-03 risk table; do not re-author it in four places.

DISCLAIM: spec-check does NOT verify SPEC CONSISTENCY (contradictory clauses) — it does keyword/structure proxies only, and it is advisory. The engine already prints this; say it once in the SKILL too, and make the non-correlated SPEC review a real human/second-agent step rather than implying the lint covers it.

DISCLAIM: mutation testing (pit-check) is NOT an inner-loop gate — it is scheduled/incremental by design (CONSTITUTION:94). Say where it runs so operators stop expecting readiness to reflect test effectiveness live.

DISCLAIM: the golden PreToolUse hook is a speed-bump against the reflexive 'edit the golden to make it pass' move, NOT a security boundary — a determined agent can still hand-write a .received. Don't oversell it as tamper-proof.

CUT the prose that claims enforcement the engine doesn't perform: 'CONSTITUTION breach caps readiness ≤65 by construction' (until the flag-blocker primitive exists) and any CONSTITUTION line implying pit-check/gate-check/golden-diff run automatically in the loop. Under-claim, then wire, then re-claim — a maker!=checker method must not assert gates it doesn't run.

CUT the shipped inconsistencies that erode trust at first contact: the phantom 'improve-deep' tool token, the 9 per-patch CHANGELOG files + stale 1.2.0 version, and the two wrong CWE citations. A methodology whose own citations don't check out undercuts its 'over-attributing lies' principle on line one.
